# Setup

```{r, include = FALSE}

#To clear the workspace
rm(list = ls(all = T))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy = TRUE, message=FALSE)

# My theme
theme.dgm <- function () {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, 
           base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
}

theme.dgm.map <- function (){
  theme_bw(base_size = 12, 
           base_family = "serif") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) 
}
```

# Physical Characteristics

## Inital radii measures

```{r}
radii_before <- phys_char_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment_Code)) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(Before_radius_mm),
            se = sd(Before_radius_mm)/sqrt(length(Before_radius_mm)))
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
experimental_stars <- phys_char_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment_Code)) %>%
  mutate(diff_radius = After_radius_mm - Before_radius_mm,
         diff_wet_weight = After_wet_mass_g - Before_wet_mass_g) %>%
  mutate(Temp_Treatment = factor(Temp_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("Temp_10C", "Temp_15C"),
                                 labels = c("10°C", "15°C")),
         Food_Treatment = factor(Food_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("fed", "unfed"),
                                 labels = c("Access\nto food", 
                                            "No access\nto food"))) %>%
  left_join(read.csv(here("03_cleaned_data", "AFDM_clean.csv")), 
            by = join_by(ID == SeaStar_ID)) %>%
  mutate(Meta_Cat = case_when(
           Temp_Treatment == "10°C" & Metabolic_Temp_Treatment == "Meta_10C" ~ "Same as Tank",
           Temp_Treatment == "10°C" & Metabolic_Temp_Treatment == "Meta_15C" ~ "Elevated",
           Temp_Treatment == "15°C" & Metabolic_Temp_Treatment == "Meta_15C" ~ "Same as Tank",
           Temp_Treatment == "15°C" & Metabolic_Temp_Treatment == "Meta_20C" ~ "Elevated"
         ),
         Meta_Cat = factor(Meta_Cat, 
                                 levels = c("Same as Tank", 
                                            "Elevated")),
         Mesocosm_Number = case_when(
           Temp_Treatment == "10°C" & Sampling_Day_Treatment == "1st_Sampling" ~ "Tank_3",
           Temp_Treatment == "10°C" & Sampling_Day_Treatment == "2nd_Sampling" ~ "Tank_4",
           Temp_Treatment == "15°C" & Sampling_Day_Treatment == "1st_Sampling" ~ "Tank_1",
           Temp_Treatment == "15°C" & Sampling_Day_Treatment == "2nd_Sampling" ~ "Tank_2"
        ))
```




## Change in Radius

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=6}
(arm_radius_boxplot <- ggplot(experimental_stars, 
                              aes(x = Food_Treatment, y = diff_radius, 
                                  fill = Temp_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9D4388", "#4472CA")) +
  labs(x = "\nFood Access Treatment", y = "Change in arm radius (mm)\n", fill = "Aquaria\nTemperature\nTreatment") +
  theme(legend.position = "top"))

```


### Model


```{r, fig.show='hide'}
# hist(experimental_stars$diff_radius)

diff_radius_mod_full <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment + 
                             (1|Mesocosm_Number), 
                        data = experimental_stars)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_full))

```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
diff_radius_mod_no_re <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment, 
                        data = experimental_stars)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_no_re))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
diff_radius_mod_no_inter <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment + Temp_Treatment, 
                        data = experimental_stars)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_no_inter))
```


#### AICc

```{r}
AICc(diff_radius_mod_full, diff_radius_mod_no_re, diff_radius_mod_no_inter) %>%
  arrange(AICc) %>%
  mutate(Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc)) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, align = "c", caption = "Difference in Radius Models") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

diff_radius_best_mod <- diff_radius_mod_no_inter
```

#### Best Model

```{r}
summary(diff_radius_best_mod)
```



```{r}

CI_diff_radius_best_mod <- tidy(diff_radius_best_mod, effects = "fixed", 
                                      conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "profile") %>%
  mutate(significance = if_else(conf.low > 0 | conf.high < 0, "Sig", "No Sig"),
         significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Sig", "No Sig")))%>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food" ~  "No access to food",                         
    term == "Temp_Treatment15°C" ~ "15°C"
  ))



(plot_CI_diff_radius_best_mod <- ggplot(CI_diff_radius_best_mod, 
                                           aes(x = estimate, 
                                               y = reorder(term, estimate), 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  labs(x = "\nModel Estimates (± CI)", y = "Predictor Variables\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))

```

# Metabolic Rates

```{r}

meta_rates <- meta_rates_raw %>%
  mutate(Tank_Treatment = factor(as.factor(Tank_Treatment), levels = c("10", "15"),
                                 labels = c("10°C", "15°C")),
         Meta_Treatment = factor(as.factor(Meta_Treatment), 
                                 levels = c("10", "15", "20"),
                                 labels = c("10°C", "15°C", "20°C")),
         Food_Treatment = factor(as.factor(Food_Treatment), 
                                 levels = c("fed", "unfed"),
                                 labels = c("Access\nto food", 
                                            "No access\nto food")),
         Meta_Cat = case_when(
           Tank_Treatment == "10°C" & Meta_Treatment == "10°C" ~ "Same as\nAquaria",
           Tank_Treatment == "10°C" & Meta_Treatment == "15°C" ~ "Elevated\n5°C",
           Tank_Treatment == "15°C" & Meta_Treatment == "15°C" ~ "Same as\nAquaria",
           Tank_Treatment == "15°C" & Meta_Treatment == "20°C" ~ "Elevated\n5°C"
         ),
         Meta_Cat = factor(Meta_Cat, 
                                 levels = c("Same as\nAquaria", 
                                            "Elevated\n5°C")),
         mass_spec_O2 = -1 * mass_spec_O2, 
         Mesocosm_Number = case_when(
           Tank_Treatment == "10°C" & Sampling_Day == "1st_Sampling" ~ "Tank_3",
           Tank_Treatment == "10°C" & Sampling_Day == "2nd_Sampling" ~ "Tank_4",
           Tank_Treatment == "15°C" & Sampling_Day == "1st_Sampling" ~ "Tank_1",
           Tank_Treatment == "15°C" & Sampling_Day == "2nd_Sampling" ~ "Tank_2"
        )) %>%
  rename(Temp_Treatment = Tank_Treatment)
  
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}

(respirometry_boxplot <- ggplot(meta_rates, aes(x = Meta_Cat, y = mass_spec_O2,
                       alpha = Food_Treatment, fill = Temp_Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = temp_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.3)) +
  labs(x= "\nRespirometry Temperature", 
       y = expression(bold("Mass Specific O"[2]*" Rate (mL h"^{-1}*"g"^{-1}*")")),
       alpha = "Food Access\nTreatment", fill = "Aquaria\nTemperature\nTreatment") +
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "darkgrey"))) +
  facet_wrap(~Temp_Treatment) + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 12))))

```


## Model


```{r, fig.show='hide'}
meta_mod_full <- glmmTMB(mass_spec_O2 ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + Meta_Cat:Food_Treatment +
                                    Meta_Cat:Temp_Treatment + (1|Mesocosm_Number), 
                        data = meta_rates)

plot(simulateResiduals(meta_mod_full))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
meta_mod_no_re <- glmmTMB(mass_spec_O2 ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + Meta_Cat:Food_Treatment +
                                    Meta_Cat:Temp_Treatment , 
                        data = meta_rates)

plot(simulateResiduals(meta_mod_no_re))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
meta_mod_one_inter <- glmmTMB(mass_spec_O2 ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat, 
                        data = meta_rates)

plot(simulateResiduals(meta_mod_one_inter))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
meta_mod_no_inter <- glmmTMB(mass_spec_O2 ~ Food_Treatment + Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat, 
                        data = meta_rates)

plot(simulateResiduals(meta_mod_no_inter))
```

#### AICc
```{r}
AICc(meta_mod_full, meta_mod_no_re, meta_mod_one_inter, meta_mod_no_inter) %>%
  arrange(AICc) %>%
  mutate(Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc)) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, align = "c", caption = "meta Models") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

meta_best_mod <- meta_mod_one_inter
```

#### Best Model

```{r}
summary(meta_best_mod)
```



```{r}

CI_meta_best_mod <- tidy(meta_best_mod, effects = "fixed",

    term == "Meta_CatElevated\n5°C" ~ "Elevated respirometry\ntemperature",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Temp_Treatment15°C" ~ "No access to food:\n15°C"
  ))


(plot_CI_meta_best_mod <- ggplot(CI_meta_best_mod, 
                                           aes(x = estimate, 
                                               y = reorder(term, estimate), 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +

  theme(legend.position = "none"))
```

# Resistance Time

```{r}

treatment_classifications <- meta_rates %>%
  dplyr::select(Seastar_ID, Food_Treatment, Temp_Treatment,
                Meta_Treatment, Sampling_Day, Meta_Cat, Mesocosm_Number)

weights <- experimental_stars %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Dry_mass_g, Ash_mass_g, AFDM_g)

resistance_clean <- resistance_raw %>%
  mutate(resistance_time_s = hour(resistance_raw$Time_Elapsed) * 3600 +
                           minute(resistance_raw$Time_Elapsed) * 60 +
                           second(resistance_raw$Time_Elapsed),
         resistance_time_m = resistance_time_s/60,
         resistance_time_h = resistance_time_m/60) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, resistance_time_s, resistance_time_m, resistance_time_h) %>%
  left_join(treatment_classifications, by = join_by("ID" == "Seastar_ID")) %>%
  left_join(weights, by = join_by(ID == ID)) 

```

```{r}

(resistance_boxplot <- ggplot(resistance_clean, aes(x = Meta_Cat, y = resistance_time_h,
                       alpha = Food_Treatment, fill = Temp_Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = temp_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.3)) +
  labs(x= "\nRespirometry Temperature", y = "Resistance Time (h)\n",
       alpha = "Food Access\nTreatment", fill = "Aquaria\nTemperature\nTreatment") +
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "darkgrey")))+
  facet_wrap(~Temp_Treatment))


```






## Model

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
resistance_mod_full <- glmmTMB(resistance_time_h ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + Meta_Cat:Food_Treatment +
                                    Meta_Cat:Temp_Treatment + scale(AFDM_g) + 
                                 (1|Mesocosm_Number), 
                        data = resistance_clean)

plot(simulateResiduals(resistance_mod_full))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
resistance_mod_no_re <- glmmTMB(resistance_time_h ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + Meta_Cat:Food_Treatment +
                                    Meta_Cat:Temp_Treatment + scale(AFDM_g), 
                        data = resistance_clean)

plot(simulateResiduals(resistance_mod_no_re))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
resistance_mod_one_inter <- glmmTMB(resistance_time_h ~ Food_Treatment*Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + scale(AFDM_g), 
                        data = resistance_clean)

plot(simulateResiduals(resistance_mod_one_inter))
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
resistance_mod_no_inter <- glmmTMB(resistance_time_h ~ Food_Treatment + Temp_Treatment+
                                    Meta_Cat + scale(AFDM_g), 
                        data = resistance_clean)

plot(simulateResiduals(resistance_mod_no_inter))
```

```{r}
  kable(digits = 2, align = "c", caption = "Resistance Models") %>%
```

# Feeding Rates


## Over Time

```{r}

classifications <- experimental_stars %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Food_Treatment, Temp_Treatment, Meta_Cat, Mesocosm_Number)

feeding_clean <- feeding_raw  %>%
  left_join(classifications, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Food_Treatment) & !is.na(Temp_Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(Phase = case_when(
           Timepoint %in% c("Feeding_1", "Feeding_2", "Feeding_3") ~ "PreExperiment",
           Timepoint %in% c("Feeding_4", "Feeding_5", "Feeding_6", 
                            "Feeding_7", "Feeding_8") ~ "Experiment"
         ),
         Day_cont = case_when(
           Timepoint == "Feeding_4" ~ 4,
           Timepoint == "Feeding_5" ~ 8,
           Timepoint == "Feeding_6" ~ 12,
           Timepoint == "Feeding_7" ~ 16,
           Timepoint == "Feeding_8" ~ 20,
           .default = NA
         ),
         Heat_Colors = case_when(
           Temp_Treatment == "10°C" ~ "#9D4388",
           Temp_Treatment == "15°C" ~ "#4472CA"
         ),
         Amount_Eatten = as.numeric(Amount_Eatten)) %>%
  rename(Amount_Eaten = Amount_Eatten)

```

```{r, fig.width=24, fig.height=35}

ggplot(feeding_clean, aes(x = Date, y = Amount_Eaten, color = ID,
                          alpha = Phase)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  theme.dgm() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = feeding_clean$Heat_Colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ID, ncol = 8) 

```

```{r, fig.width=24, fig.height=35}

feeding_experiments <- feeding_clean %>%
  filter(Phase == "Experiment" & 
         Food_Treatment == "Access\nto food")

ggplot(feeding_experiments, aes(x = Date, y = Amount_Eaten, color = ID,
                          alpha = Phase)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  theme.dgm() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = feeding_clean$Heat_Colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ID, ncol = 6) 

```

### Rates

```{r}

feeding_rate_df <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:length(unique(feeding_experiments$ID))){
  
  xx_df <- feeding_experiments %>%
    filter(ID == unique(feeding_experiments$ID)[i])
  
  xx_cor <- cor.test(xx_df$Day_cont, xx_df$Amount_Eaten, 
                     method = "spearman", exact=FALSE)
  
  xx_values <- data.frame(ID = unique(feeding_experiments$ID)[i], 
                          Temp_Treatment = xx_df$Temp_Treatment[1],
                          Rho = xx_cor$estimate)
  row.names(xx_values) <- NULL
  
  feeding_rate_df <- rbind(feeding_rate_df, xx_values)
  
}

feeding_rate_df[is.na(feeding_rate_df)] <- 0


```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

(rate_feeding_boxplot <- ggplot(feeding_rate_df, 
                             aes(x = Temp_Treatment, y = Rho, fill = Temp_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9D4388", "#4472CA"))+
  labs(x = "\nAquaria Temperature Treatment", y = "Correlation of Mussel\nConsumption Over Time\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")) 

```


### Model
```{r}

# hist(feeding_rate_df$Rho)

wilcox.test(Rho ~ Temp_Treatment,
                      data = feeding_rate_df, exact=FALSE)

```

## Overall

```{r}

feeding_experiments_sum <- feeding_experiments %>%
  group_by(ID, Food_Treatment, Temp_Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_fed = 5,
            total_ate = sum(Amount_Eaten)) %>%
  mutate(Prop_Ate = total_ate/total_fed)

```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

(total_feeding_boxplot <- ggplot(feeding_experiments_sum, 
                             aes(x = Temp_Treatment, y = Prop_Ate, fill = Temp_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9D4388", "#4472CA"))+
  labs(x = "\nAquaria Temperature Treatment", y="\nTotal Proportion of Mussels Ate\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")) 

```


### Model

```{r}
# hist(feeding_experiments_sum$Prop_Ate)

wilcox.test(Prop_Ate ~ Temp_Treatment,
                      data = feeding_experiments_sum,exact=FALSE)
```

```{r}
feeding_mod_sum <- feeding_experiments_sum %>%
  group_by(Temp_Treatment) %>%
  summarize(mean_prop = mean(Prop_Ate),
            se_prop = sd(Prop_Ate) / sqrt(length(Prop_Ate)))

# 10-15
feeding_mod_sum$mean_prop[1] - feeding_mod_sum$mean_prop[2]
```
